topics.topic: Indices, Logarithms and Surds: Rationalization and conjugate surds
learningObjectives: Apply laws of fractional and negative indices to solve algebraic equations
Solve logarithmic equations in various bases using change of base formula
Simplify surds and rationalize binomial surd denominators using conjugates

topics.topic: Sets and Operations: Venn diagrams with three sets and algebra of sets
learningObjectives: Define universal set, subsets, intersection, union, and set complements
Solve three-set real-world optimization problems using Venn diagrams
Prove De Morgan’s laws and algebraic identities for sets

topics.topic: Binary Operations: Properties (closure, commutativity, associativity, distributivity)
learningObjectives: Determine closure, commutativity, and associativity of arbitrary binary operations
Find identity elements and inverse elements under defined operations
Construct and interpret Cayley operational tables for finite sets

topics.topic: Polynomials: Remainder Theorem, Factor Theorem, and Synthetic Division
learningObjectives: Perform polynomial long division and synthetic division for cubic expressions
Apply Remainder Theorem to find remainders without actual division
Use Factor Theorem to factorize cubic and quartic polynomials completely

topics.topic: Quadratic Equations: Symmetric functions of roots (alpha and beta)
learningObjectives: Relate coefficients to sum (α + β) and product (αβ) of quadratic roots
Form new quadratic equations whose roots are functions of original roots
Determine the nature of roots using the discriminant (Δ = b² - 4ac)

topics.topic: Inequalities: Linear and quadratic inequalities in one and two variables
learningObjectives: Solve linear inequalities and graph solution sets on number lines
Solve quadratic inequalities using sign charts and graphical parabolic sketches
Graph systems of linear inequalities in two variables with shaded feasible regions

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Advanced Proofs Clinic
learningObjectives: Assess pupil mastery of binary operations, polynomials, and surds
Administer timed speed test on symmetric quadratic root problems
Provide targeted step-by-step remediation on synthetic division

topics.topic: Matrices and Determinants: 2x2 matrices, operations, and inverses
learningObjectives: Perform matrix addition, scalar multiplication, and matrix multiplication
Calculate determinants of 2x2 matrices and identify singular matrices
Find inverse matrices and solve systems of simultaneous linear equations

topics.topic: Trigonometric Functions: Ratios of general angles and compound angle formulas
learningObjectives: Define trigonometric ratios in the four Cartesian quadrants (CAST rule)
Apply compound angle formulas: sin(A ± B), cos(A ± B), and tan(A ± B)
Derive double angle identities and solve simple trigonometric equations

topics.topic: Coordinate Geometry: Straight lines, distance, midpoint, and parallel/perpendicular lines
learningObjectives: Calculate distance and midpoint between two Cartesian coordinates
Find gradient and equation of a straight line (point-slope and slope-intercept forms)
Establish conditions for parallelism (m1 = m2) and perpendicularity (m1 * m2 = -1)

topics.topic: Vectors in Two Dimensions: Magnitude, direction, dot product, and resolution
learningObjectives: Represent vectors in component form (ai + bj) and column vectors
Calculate magnitude, direction angles, and unit vectors
Compute the scalar (dot) product and find angles between two 2D vectors

topics.topic: Comprehensive Further Mathematics Termly Revision & Mock Clinic
learningObjectives: Synthesize algebraic, trigonometric, coordinate, and vector concepts
Solve past WASSCE Further Mathematics Paper 1 and Paper 2 questions
Reinforce rigorous proof techniques and structured mathematical notation

topics.topic: Terminal Examination and Broadsheet Score Moderation
learningObjectives: Examine cumulative knowledge through standardized theory and objective tests
Grade solutions strictly according to West African Examinations Council criteria
Transmit compiled continuous assessment and exam marks for school records
